summary: A proposal for an Information Management and Statistical System for the ILLIAC IV, with a user language and routines for research on large databases. It would use the datacomputer for archival storage. Interested people were asked to contact the author.

eli5.summary: A plan to make a database tool for a very fast computer, which would store its old data on the network's big storage machine.

subtitle: A proposal for database and statistics tools for the ILLIAC IV supercomputer

tldr.problem: The ILLIAC IV supercomputer lacked adequate tools for managing and querying large datasets used in cutting-edge research.
tldr.mechanism: The proposal describes an Information Management and Statistical System with a user language and manipulation routines for the ILLIAC IV, leveraging the datacomputer for archival storage and handling queries not suited to the supercomputer.
tldr.outcome: A specialized system designed to support research problems requiring high-performance computation on large databases.

facts.label: Institution
facts.value: University of Illinois Center for Advanced Computation

today: RFC 299 describes early efforts to build database systems for scientific supercomputers. The proposal of using a separate archival system (the datacomputer) alongside the ILLIAC IV anticipated modern approaches to scientific data management and distributed computation.

sections.title: ILLIAC IV Data Management
sections.content: Researchers at the University of Illinois Center for Advanced Computation proposed an Information Management and Statistical System for the ILLIAC IV, one of the first supercomputers. The ILLIAC IV was suited to research problems involving intensive parallel computation on large datasets. The new system would provide a user language and necessary manipulation routines to enable this research.
sections.eli5: Scientists wanted to build tools so the ILLIAC IV supercomputer could handle databases easily.

sections.title: System Design and Storage
sections.content: The proposed system would use the datacomputer, a specialized network resource, for archival storage of large datasets. The Information Management System would interface between the ILLIAC IV and the datacomputer, routing queries and data appropriately. Queries suited to the ILLIAC IV's parallel processing would run on the supercomputer, while other queries would use the datacomputer's resources.
sections.eli5: The ILLIAC IV would handle fast calculations, and the network's datacomputer would keep and search through the big datasets.

sections.title: Research Applications
sections.content: The system was intended to support various areas of research whose problems benefited from the ILLIAC IV's speed and whose data bases were large. Dorothy Hopkin at the University of Illinois Center for Advanced Computation coordinated the development and invited interested researchers to contribute ideas or contact her for more information.
sections.eli5: Different research groups could use this system if they had big datasets and problems that needed very fast calculations.

references.text: Hopkin, D., "Information Management System", RFC 299, February 1972.
